cohort: Pregnant women aged 18-45 years, between 37-42 weeks gestation, with singleton, cephalic pregnancies, who attended at least one antenatal class at Aga Khan University Hospital Karachi.
finding: The average QACE score of 18.2 indicated that mothers generally had a positive childbirth experience, with 66.91% of women reporting a positive experience.
mod_finding: Modes of delivery revealed 57.6% of the women delivered spontaneously.
